# ACCMS

> ACCMS (Adult Content Creator Management Services) is a Belgian service that helps adult (18+) content creators in Belgium and the Netherlands grow on Instagram, TikTok, X, OnlyFans, Fansly, MYM and F2F. Creators keep their own accounts, passwords and revenue; ACCMS delivers strategy, a 90-day roadmap, a revenue forecast and technical support. No revenue share of 50%: fixed prices.

## Pages
- [Nederlands](https://www.accms.agency/): main site in Dutch
- [Français](https://www.accms.agency/fr/): site in French
- [English](https://www.accms.agency/en/): site in English

## Services and prices (excl. VAT)
- Audit + roadmap: from €199, one-off. Analysis of all profiles, 90-day roadmap per platform, revenue forecast in three scenarios, one-hour review call.
- Growth management: from €599 per month, optional 10% of net growth above the starting level, 3-month minimum. Weekly content planning, pricing and PPV strategy, customs menu, monthly KPI report.
- Tech package: €399 first year, €199 per year from year 2. Hand-coded link-in-bio website on the creator's own domain, hosting, email capture, click tracking.

## Process
1. Email request, personal reply within 48 hours
2. Free 20-minute intake
3. Audit and 90-day roadmap with revenue forecast
4. First changes live within one week
5. Weekly updates and monthly KPI review

## FAQ
- **What does it cost?** Audit + roadmap from €199, tech package €399 (from year 2 €199 per year) and growth management from €599 a month, with an optional 10% of your net growth above your starting level. All prices exclude VAT. We don't take 50% of your revenue.
- **Do I have to share my logins or passwords?** No. You keep your accounts, your passwords and your fans. We deliver the plan, the copy, the schedule and the tech; you publish.
- **I'm not active yet. Is that okay?** Yes. We build your platforms from scratch, in the right order: reach first, then revenue.
- **Is it also for male creators and couples?** Yes. The strategy depends on your audience and your niche.
- **How discreet is it?** NDA on request, no names or screenshots without your consent, and we help you keep your real identity separate from your creator name.
- **What about taxes?** Creator income is taxable in Belgium. We don't give tax advice; sort this out with an accountant.
- **How soon will I see results?** We review the first measurable numbers after 30 days. No guarantees, but a plan we adjust every month.
